meta.title: Warband × Rivals Deck Pairings
meta.description: A many-to-many compatibility guide matching all 50 OP-legal warbands to all 12 universal Rivals decks. Ratings reflect how well a warband's playstyle, model count, durability and signature mechanics line up with what each deck's objectives reward.
meta.note: Ratings + per-pairing notes only. Warband playstyles live in warbands/<slug>/warscroll.json (playstyle); deck summaries in rivals/<slug>/deck.json (strategyTagline/strategy). Polish note translations in warband-rivals-pairings.pl.json.

ratingScale.label: Signature fit
ratingScale.description: The warband's core mechanics directly power the deck's win condition.

ratingScale.label: Good fit
ratingScale.description: Plays to the warband's strengths; a solid competitive choice.

ratingScale.label: Workable
ratingScale.description: Functions, but no real synergy; situational.

ratingScale.label: Weak
ratingScale.description: The deck pulls against what the warband wants to do.

meta.method: Ratings weigh four things in order: (1) does the deck's Plot keyword match the warband, (2) do the deck's scoring objectives match the warband's behaviour, (3) model count and durability versus the objective demands, (4) Inspire-trigger alignment. The six no-Plot decks (HG, RF, WR, BL, ES, PL) are judged on objective shape directly.
